prompt:
Create ONE square image 1254x1254: a 2x2 sheet of four game skill icons for a medieval dark-fantasy turn-based RPG hero called the Thunder Skald (storm singer with a war hammer and a war drum). Match the attached reference icons EXACTLY in style, palette and framing: each icon is its own square dark tile (near-black background, very calm, no texture), painted digital fantasy style with crisp edges, storm-blue / white-blue lightning, worn brown leather, dull grey iron. The four tiles sit in a 2x2 grid with an equal thin dark gutter between them; each subject stays fully inside its own tile with a margin (nothing touches or crosses a tile edge, nothing spills into a neighbour tile). Rules for every tile: ONE clear central subject, strong readable silhouette at small size, few shapes, calm dark background, very few sparks or debris, no grain, no noise, no speckles, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no UI, no modern objects. These are EVOLVED versions of the reference skills: each is clearly related to its base icon (same main object) but visibly different.
TOP-LEFT 'Living Storm' (evolved Conductor; base = a fist gripping an upright iron hammer haft with lightning): the same leather-gloved fist gripping the upright iron haft, but the lightning now coils upward around the haft in a tight spiral and crowns the top with a small swirling storm-cloud vortex; looks alive and stronger than the base.
TOP-RIGHT 'Returning Hammer' (evolved Hammer Spark; base = hammer smashing the ground with lightning): the same blocky iron war hammer with its leather-wrapped haft, now flying alone through the air (no hand), tilted, spinning, leaving ONE big curved boomerang arc trail of blue lightning that loops back toward the viewer, showing it returns. No ground.
BOTTOM-LEFT 'Second Thunder' (evolved Thunder Strike; base = one bolt from a cloud onto broken ground): TWO parallel jagged lightning bolts falling side by side from a dark cloud band onto the same single cracked stone impact point, the second bolt slightly paler like an echo. Different from the base: two bolts, one shared impact.
BOTTOM-RIGHT 'Saga of Storms' (evolved War Drum; base = a hide war drum struck by a padded drumstick with blue sound rings): the same round wooden hide war drum seen at an angle with the padded drumstick, but a jagged lightning bolt now shoots UP out of the drum skin into the dark above, sound rings turned into crackling lightning rings. No hand needed.
